verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a password manager, and background automations such as scheduled tasks or rotation are a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a CLI for retrieving secrets inside scripts and CI/CD pipelines. That is a developer building block the user must wire into their own automation, not a product-provided way to set up autonomous background automations. Pass Monitor's built-in scanning is a fixed security feature, not a user-configured automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
